name: Iut.LocalHeightData.exists_prime_selection
elaboratedType:
∀ (L : Iut.LocalHeightData.{u_1}) (cheb : Iut.ChebyshevBound) (δ : ℝ),
  LE.le.{0} 2 δ →
    LE.le.{0} (↑(Iut.LocalHeightData.deg.{u_1} L)) δ →
      LE.le.{0} cheb.ξ √(Iut.LocalHeightData.height.{u_1} L) →
        ∃ (ℓ : ℕ),
          Nat.Prime ℓ ∧
            LE.le.{0} √(Iut.LocalHeightData.height.{u_1} L) ↑ℓ ∧
              LE.le.{0} (↑ℓ)
                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 10 δ) √(Iut.LocalHeightData.height.{u_1} L))
                    (Real.log (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 δ) (Iut.LocalHeightData.height.{u_1} L)))) ∧
                (∀ (v : Iut.LocalHeightData.ι.{u_1} L),
                    Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} (Iut.LocalHeightData.bad.{u_1} L) v →
                      ¬Dvd.dvd.{0} ℓ (Iut.LocalHeightData.hv.{u_1} L v)) ∧
                  ∀ (v : Iut.LocalHeightData.ι.{u_1} L),
                    Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} (Iut.LocalHeightData.bad.{u_1} L) v →
                      Eq.{1} (Iut.LocalHeightData.p.{u_1} L v) ℓ →
                        LT.lt.{0} ↑(Iut.LocalHeightData.hv.{u_1} L v) √(Iut.LocalHeightData.height.{u_1} L)
